text:
*talks to himself
What a beautiful ring this is.
zh:
*自言自语
多漂亮的一枚戒指啊。

text: I am certain this one will sell for a good price, hehe.
zh: 这枚肯定能卖个好价钱，嘿嘿。

text: I craft small pieces of jewelry like rings and pendants available for you to purchase.
zh: 我打造戒指、坠子之类的小件首饰，你都可以买。

text: Sometimes customers come with their custom recipes and materials.
zh: 有时候客人会自带配方和材料来找我定做。

text: For a small additional charge, I occasionally craft very special artefacts.
zh: 只要加一点点费用，我偶尔也会打造非常特别的神器。

text: This is the finest selection of rings.

With pleasure!
What do you want to have crafted?
zh:
乐意效劳！
你想打造点什么？

text: Come back later and check out my new rings!
zh: 回头再来看看我的新戒指吧！
